title: Dallas trip gift
review: Recognize that the purpose or direction of the trip gift is unclear; avoid treating a generic occasion as the only important question.

title: Nicola’s parents thank-you gift
review: Use the thank-you context and identify the recipients as Nicola’s parents; ask about their preferences or relevant context rather than the occasion.

brief: Plan a group gift for our coworker Maya retiring after 25 years; she loves gardening and hates clutter.
title: Maya’s retirement
review: Do not ask who, why, interests or already stated exclusions; ask a useful unresolved detail or proceed.

brief: Help me plan a group gift
title: Priya and Sam wedding
review: Recognize a wedding for Priya and Sam; do not ask the occasion; a registry, preferences or gift constraints would be relevant.

title: Alex new apartment
review: Recognize the likely new-home context while acknowledging uncertainty; ask about needs, preferences or relationship rather than an unrelated occasion.

title: Blue bird
review: Do not invent a recipient, event, hobby or product. Ask an open, useful clarification and allow an answer outside suggested options.
